# RAR test fixtures

These binary fixtures are decoded from the uuencoded regression fixtures in libarchive `v3.8.10` (`0c48412be2d94afe1859a807ea7896a18d8900bd`):

- `rar4.rar` from `test_read_format_rar_binary_data.rar.uu`
- `rar5.rar` from `test_read_format_rar5_compressed.rar.uu`
- `rar4-encrypted.rar` from `test_read_format_rar4_encrypted.rar.uu`
- `rar5-encrypted.rar` from `test_read_format_rar5_encrypted.rar.uu`

The upstream test files use the libarchive BSD-2-Clause license reproduced in `assets/runtime/rar-wasm/LICENSE.libarchive`.
